# Bima Suraksha — Ram Singh Rathore, LIC Advisor

> LIC of India life insurance advisory by Ram Singh Rathore, a veteran advisor with 20+ years of experience, based in Agra, Uttar Pradesh, India. Honest, jargon-free guidance on LIC plans, plus free consultations for families in India and abroad.

Ram Singh Rathore is a Distinguished DM Club member who has helped protect 1000+ families. The site explains LIC policies in plain English — entry age, policy term, minimum cover, payout style, worked examples, tax notes and honest "not ideal for" caveats — so visitors can understand a plan before speaking to anyone.

Contact: 9837016351 · ramsinghrathore250@gmail.com · Jawahar Nagar, Khandari Road, Agra.
